NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair
NewsArticle.Content: .01.09 Dartanian Lestor, Aisling and longstanding organizer in Mileth, writes of the first Aisling-hosted fair, hosted by Mileth Village: Mileth Festival: Registration and Sign-ups - Introduction Mundanes worked hard at clearing an area specifically for this grand event, and I have looked at it. They've done wonderful work so far and hopefully the festival itself fills that promise. We have many events lined up but we need people to work them as well participate in them. Here is a list of the various things that we may have with your help: - Gaming - Tournaments - Storytelling and Plays - Wares and Auctions - Crafts, Discussions, and Tours Any general festival questions can be directed to Dartanian as well. Also, he can be contacted if ye do not see any of these aislings active in Temuair often. Any additional event suggestions are appreciated and can be sent to either Dartanian or the appropriate contact. Thank ye and I hope ye have a great time there. -Dartanian Lestor (( The festival will be held Fri, Jan 7th 5:00 PM pst, to Sun Jan, 9th 10 PM pst. A reminder will be sent out closer to that time. It will be closed from midnight to 8 AM PST unless several people wish to sign to host those times. It will also be closed whenever there is a lack in workers for events. ))
